objective: Restore the previously removed Android title-bar sponsor and managed Organization/Sub-organization/Cluster Home and Community header ad placements, while keeping existing native feed, Reels, rewarded, interstitial and video monetization systems intact.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current main contains working NativeAd-first Wall/feed placements, Reels inline NativeAd placement, first-view Home/Profile/Connect placements, rewarded Ad-Light/Garden flows, natural-break interstitial opportunities and optional IMA video integration. However BuklodHeaderSponsor explicitly returns null on Android; SwipeDashboardHeader sets no placement for Messages, Prayer or Profile; and the Organization/Cluster scoped header banner was removed from the shared header and Android/web platform implementations are no-ops.
chosenApproach: Restore Android title-bar sponsor fallback through the existing paid-campaign and AdMob banner components; map the existing Messages, Prayer and Profile title-bar routes to their already-defined placement keys; restore managed Organization/Sub-organization/Cluster Home and Community header placements using the shared guarded BuklodAdMobBanner API and existing paid local campaigns. Keep scoped Connect free of header ads to avoid showing ads inside chat/composer surfaces.
preserveBehaviors: Existing NativeAd-first Wall and first-view placements remain unchanged.
Existing Reels NativeAd/inline fallback, rewarded, interstitial and IMA video integrations remain unchanged.
Ad consent, route safety, viewport visibility, network/foreground checks, remote placement kill switches and shared cooldown remain authoritative.
No new ad unit IDs, SDK packages, database schema, production secrets or native dependencies are introduced.
No ads are added inside active message threads, calls, quiz/exam, form submission or transaction flows.
acceptanceChecks: Android title-bar sponsor no longer returns null and still prefers approved paid local campaigns.
Home, Messages, Learn, Community, Prayer and Profile tab routes map to the existing title-bar sponsor placements.
Managed Organization/Sub-organization/Cluster Home and Community headers render the guarded shared ad component.
Scoped Connect headers do not render ads.
Focused source regression tests and TypeScript pass.
Production OTA is not triggered by this PR.
alternativeApproaches: Restore direct BannerAd in scoped header; rejected because it bypasses shared consent, viewport, cooldown and remote kill-switch gates.
Add ads to scoped Connect; rejected because chat/composer interactions should remain uninterrupted.
